texts.DesignSystem:Intro: This page copies no values — every sample reads the --apya-* tokens live. It reacts instantly to the theme and density toggles.
texts.DesignSystem:Colors:Note: Positive/negative colour is never used alone — always paired with a ▲/▼ icon.
texts.DesignSystem:Surfaces:Note: Hierarchy: app-bg < sidebar ≈ base < raised < elevated
texts.DesignSystem:Typography:Note: The UI scale (--apya-fs-*) is for dense surfaces. Monetary values are always mono + tabular-nums, right-aligned.
texts.DesignSystem:Table:Note: Row height is bound to density via --row-h; try the density toggle in the header.

texts.Tour:Slide:Welcome:Title: Welcome to Apya Platform
texts.Tour:Slide:Welcome:Body: Your projects, your team and your money come together on one screen. This short tour shows you where to start.
texts.Tour:Slide:Flow:Title: How work flows end to end
texts.Tour:Slide:Flow:Body: Customer, project, task, money and reports feed each other — you never enter the same information twice.
texts.Tour:Slide:Overview:Title: Overview: where your day starts
texts.Tour:Slide:Overview:Body: The first screen tells you what needs attention today; every number links to the list behind it.
texts.Tour:Slide:Projects:Title: Every project has its own console
texts.Tour:Slide:Projects:Body: Progress and budget sit side by side, so you never have to guess whether a project is profitable.
texts.Tour:Slide:Finance:Title: Invoices, expenses and payments in one ledger
texts.Tour:Slide:Finance:Body: You enter the record; the cash account, the customer ledger and the project cost update behind the scenes.
texts.Tour:Slide:Start:Title: You are ready to start
texts.Tour:Slide:Start:Body: Download the full presentation as PDF, and reopen this tour any time from the user menu.

texts.Grants:Public:MetaDescription: Open grant calls in Türkiye in one place: support rate, eligibility criteria and application difficulty.
texts.Grants:Public:Footer:Note: Call data is compiled from official sources; read the institution's own text before applying.
texts.Grants:Public:Search:Title: Open grant calls
texts.Grants:Public:Search:Headline: Open grant calls in Türkiye, in one place
texts.Grants:Public:Search:Lede: Every call opens down to its support rate and eligibility criteria. No membership needed — filter, compare, measure your eligibility.
texts.Grants:Public:Search:Placeholder: Search a grant, institution or keyword
texts.Grants:Public:Search:EmptyFiltered: No calls match these filters. Widen the amount range or set the deadline filter to "all".
texts.Grants:Public:Search:EmptyAll: No open calls are published right now. New calls appear here as they go live.
texts.Grants:Public:Cta:Headline: Which one are you actually eligible for?
texts.Grants:Public:Cta:Lede: Pick a call and measure your eligibility in five questions. No membership, no email — see the result directly.
texts.Grants:Public:Criterion:Consortium: A joint application by at least {0} organisations
texts.Grants:Public:Test:Title: Am I eligible for this grant?
texts.Grants:Public:Test:NoWall: No membership, no email. See the result directly.
texts.Grants:Public:Test:Partial: Based on your answers so far
texts.Grants:Public:Test:NotEligible: As things stand you are not eligible for this call
texts.Grants:Public:Test:Blocking: Missing: {0}. Applications are not evaluated until this criterion is met.
texts.Grants:Public:Test:HonestNeed: Honest assessment: this call carries a heavy document load and process. Most companies doing it for the first time cannot finish in the last two weeks — we recommend support.
texts.Grants:Public:Test:HonestNoNeed: Honest assessment: you can run this call on your own. Easy calls do not need support; we are not recommending consulting.

texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Title: Pre-assessment call
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Headline: Let's arrange a call
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Lede: This is not a sales call. We look at your test answers and discuss whether you really stand a chance in this call, and what you would need to complete.
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust1:Title: No charge
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust1:Body: We do not charge for the pre-assessment; the outcome is yours to keep.
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust2:Title: 30 minutes
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust2:Body: One call is enough. We do not stretch it.
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust3:Title: We say so if you are not eligible
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust3:Body: Writing an application that fails a criterion helps nobody.
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust4:Title: We also say so if you can do it alone
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:Trust4:Body: We do not recommend consulting on easy calls.
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:PreferenceOnly: This is a preference; the consultant will confirm availability and get back to you. It is not a confirmed appointment slot.
texts.Grants:Public:Meeting:DoneBody: The consultant will confirm availability and get back to you. If you do not hear the same day, follow up by email.
